LanguageData.RR_Gate_CutoffDesc:
End this opening immediately and start the emergency return window, so anyone on the far side comes home.
The gate stays usable afterwards. This is not the kill switch, which stays thrown until you clear it.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_Desc:
Bind an ordinary door next to this gate into the same opening, so a wider gate can be built out of several plain doors.
The whole run becomes one gate with one width on both sides. It costs more to power and more work to bring up, because it is more machine. Releasing the run turns the extra doors back into ordinary doors.
Neither can be done while the gate is working.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_Release: Release the run back to ordinary doors
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_NoCandidate: No ordinary door beside this gate could join it
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_NotAGate: That door is not a designated gate.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_AlreadyAnExtension: That door is already part of another gate.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_AlreadyAGate: That door is a gate in its own right. Undesignate it first.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_ActiveCannotExtend: A gate’s opening cannot be changed while the gate is working. Wait for the opening to end, or abort the spin-up.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_NotADoor: That is not an ordinary door this branch owns.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_SameDoor: A gate cannot take in itself.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_NotSingleCell: Only a one-cell door can be taken into a run. A wider door is already a wider gate.
LanguageData.RR_GateRun_NotASolidRun: That would not make a solid opening. A run has to be a filled rectangle, and no larger than the biggest gate size.
LanguageData.RR_Event_GateRunExtended: {0} is now an opening of {1} doors, {2} cells wide.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_Explanation: Choose one specific Core door and explicitly link its control console, real battery, and machining bench. Rimrooms never chooses the nearest door or infrastructure automatically.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_HQContext: Current company branch: {0}. Eligible links below are limited to headquarters map {1}.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_MachineInstructions: Bind a Core door to its selected CommsConsole, Battery, and TableMachining before assembly or operation. Complete the physical bill at the selected TableMachining, assign an operator, calibrate, and keep the operator at the console for an opening.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NoHeadquarters: The company headquarters map is unavailable.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SelectDoor: Select a Core Door or Autodoor
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NoSelectedGate: No gate is selected. Choose a specific Core Door or Autodoor on the headquarters map.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_AvailableDoorCount: Eligible native gate doors on this headquarters map: {0}. Choose one door explicitly.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NoDoorCandidates: No eligible native gate doors were found on this headquarters map.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_RecordedRunGate: Saved expedition {0} is bound to {1} at {2}. Its gate cannot be replaced.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_RecordedGateUnavailable: Saved expedition {0} has no available gate component. Keep its record intact and resolve the missing gate through recovery.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_BindBeforeOperation: Bind the selected door to valid infrastructure before calibration, staffing, or dispatch.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_StationUnbound: Not bound to a gate. Designate a door as a gate in Operations, then bind this as its control station.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_StationGateControl: Running the gate. Its other bills are suspended until it returns to normal operation.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_StationNormalOp: Normal operation. Switch to gate control to run the gate from here.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NoRoleCandidates: No eligible existing building was found for this selection: {0}.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_OppositeEntrySide: Use the opposite side of the door as the expedition approach
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_EntrySideLocked: The saved expedition locks the approach to the {0}.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_Designated: This door is the company's designated native gate.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NotDesignated: This door is not designated. Saving a valid binding designates this exact door.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_DesignateGate: Save links and designate this gate
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_OpeningCannotRebind: The gate's saved opening is active. Infrastructure links cannot be changed until it closes.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_SharedBatteryWarning: The linked battery is a real RimWorld battery on a shared power network. Other consumers can drain it; Rimrooms does not reserve its charge or guarantee emergency power.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_DoorStateExplanation: The connection window is Rimrooms expedition state. The door's ordinary Open/Hold Open state only controls local pawn passage and is not proof that a connection is active.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_DispatchNeedsBoundGate: Select and designate a native gate before dispatch. Existing expeditions remain attached to their saved gate.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_PowerReadout: Stored on the gate's circuit: {0}/{1} watt-days. Gate load: {2} W, carried by the grid like any building, generators first and then every battery on the circuit equally. Charge needed for normal window plus emergency return: {3} watt-days; recovery opening total: {4} watt-days.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ReserveTooSmall: That battery is too small to hold an emergency return. A gate backed by a reserve it cannot come home on would look finished and strand the first crew through it.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_UnsupportedProvider: Only a Core Door or Autodoor can be designated as a native gate.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_UnknownSchema: The saved native gate binding uses an unsupported schema. Preserve the save and request a migration review.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ActiveCannotRebind: The gate is open or a saved expedition still depends on this gate. Its designation cannot be cleared.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_HeadquartersRequired: Choose existing player-owned infrastructure standing on this same map, at the headquarters or at a site the branch has on the books. A gate runs on the equipment beside it, never on equipment somewhere else.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_EntryBlocked: The selected door approach cell is blocked or outside the map. Choose the other side or clear the threshold.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_EntryLocked: A saved expedition has locked this door position and approach side. Keep the recorded route unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ProviderAlreadyBound: One or more selected infrastructure buildings are already linked to another gate. Choose unlinked buildings or inspect the existing designation.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_AssemblyInProgress: A gate assembly job is using one of the selected stations. Let it finish before changing bindings.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_BindingInterrupted: The binding update was interrupted. Inspect the existing gate links before retrying.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_NotBound: Bind this door to a console, battery, and assembly workbench before operation.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_LinkMissing: A linked building is missing, moved, unpowered, or no longer belongs to this headquarters. Repair its exact saved link.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_Disconnected: The console, battery, and threshold are not connected to the same live power network.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_PowerUnavailable: The native infrastructure is switched off, broken down, EMP-disabled, or affected by an electrical outage.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_OpeningEnergyLow: The linked physical battery does not contain enough charge for the configured opening and emergency-return reserve.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_RecoveryEnergyLow: The linked physical battery does not contain enough charge for the configured recovery opening and emergency-return reserve.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ReturnEnergyUnavailable: The linked physical battery cannot pay the emergency return charge. Other consumers may have used its shared stored energy.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_EnergyDebitFault: Review and acknowledge the unresolved battery debit before attempting another native gate energy charge.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_DebitFaultDetails: Unresolved energy debit {0}: requested {1} watt-days; observed change {2} watt-days.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_DebitFaultExplanation: Acknowledgment records that you reviewed the observed loss. It does not refill the battery or refund the company.
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ReducedMotion: Reduce gate motion (hide aura; keep status text)
LanguageData.RR_NativeGate_ReserveBreakdown: Of that, {0} watt-days is held back for an emergency return, and a recovery opening costs {1} watt-days.
LanguageData.RR_GateAddress_SetDesc: Choose which place this gate connects to. Remembering an address costs nothing and can be changed; a map is only built when somebody crosses.
LanguageData.RR_GateAddress_NoneKnown: This branch has no addresses yet. Dial an unknown address with this gate, or take a company request.
LanguageData.RR_GateAddress_OpenDesc: Bring up the connection to a remembered address. The assigned operator must stay on the powered console while it comes up.
LanguageData.RR_GateAddress_NoAddressSet: No address is remembered on this gate yet. Set one first.
LanguageData.RR_GateAddress_AlreadyOpen: This gate already holds an open connection.
LanguageData.RR_GateAddress_AlreadyRamping: This gate is already coming up. Watch its readout, or abort.
